---
title: "NYC Restaurant Inspections, 2017–2019"
output:
  flexdashboard::flex_dashboard:
    orientation: columns
    vertical_layout: fill
---

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(p8105.datasets)
library(plotly)
library(flexdashboard)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
```

```{r load-clean}
data("rest_inspec")

# one row per inspection; inspections from 01/2017-09/2019
# drop rows with a missing borough or invalid score
inspections =
  rest_inspec |>
  mutate(inspection_date = as.Date(inspection_date)) |>
  filter(
    boro != "0",
    !is.na(score),
    score >= 0,
    inspection_date >= as.Date("2017-01-01"),
    inspection_date < as.Date("2019-10-01")
  ) |>
  distinct(camis, inspection_date, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
  mutate(
    cuisine_description =
      str_replace(cuisine_description, "^Latin.*", "Latin American")
  ) |>
  select(
    camis, dba, boro, cuisine_description, inspection_date,
    score, grade, latitude, longitude
  )

# most recent inspection for each restaurant
latest_inspection = 
  inspections |> 
  group_by(camis) |> 
  filter(min_rank(desc(inspection_date)) == 1) |> 
  ungroup()
```

Column {data-width=600}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Most recent inspection score for a random sample of 2,500 Manhattan restaurants

```{r scatter-manhattan-map}
set.seed(8105)

latest_inspection |> 
  filter(
    boro == "Manhattan", 
    latitude != 0, 
    !is.na(latitude),
    score <= 40
  ) |> 
  sample_n(2500) |> 
  mutate(
    text_label = 
      str_c(
        dba, "\nCuisine: ", cuisine_description, 
        "\nScore: ", score, "\nInspected: ", inspection_date
      )
  ) |> 
  plot_ly(
    x = ~longitude, y = ~latitude, type = "scatter", mode = "markers",
    color = ~score, text = ~text_label, alpha = 0.5
  ) |> 
  layout(
    xaxis = list(title = "Longitude"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Latitude")
  )

```

Column {data-width=400}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Citywide distribution of most recent inspection scores for the 10 most common cuisines

```{r box-cuisine-scores}
top_cuisines = 
  latest_inspection |> 
  count(cuisine_description) |> 
  filter(min_rank(desc(n)) <= 10) |> 
  pull(cuisine_description)

latest_inspection |> 
  filter(cuisine_description %in% top_cuisines) |> 
  mutate(cuisine_description = fct_reorder(cuisine_description, score)) |> 
  plot_ly(y = ~score, color = ~cuisine_description, type = "box", colors = "viridis") |> 
  layout(
    xaxis = list(title = ""),
    yaxis = list(title = "Inspection score")
  )
```
